acceptance: 8单以内全部排定或逐单明确未排原因；校验指名与时段优先、午休培训、缓冲和项目房型，输出利用率与负荷状态；保留当日排班表、负荷图、JSON，仅店长与当事技师可见相应信息。

metric_definitions.overall_score: 9/9 selected original synthetic source-operation receipt cases; not general Agent quality or full release readiness
metric_definitions.test_coverage: 9/9 primary action IDs mapped to actual source-case proofs; not source line/branch coverage or all conditional/customer scenarios
metric_definitions.documentation_score: 82/82 declared current client/definition/license files; not an editorial quality grade

issues.description: R78 encryption and comprehensive security review remain unaccepted. This is fixed local synthetic source scope, not a production security certification.

performance_baseline.scope: three sequential read-only installed contract GETs; empirical maximum, not concurrency, general SLA or workload performance
performance_baseline.memory_scope: historical e57 process observation only; current process memory not measured

limitations: other Hosts and phone interaction not verified
server installation on another machine not verified
quality_report.scope: nine exact synthetic current-DA actions plus actual main-Skill handover and event; no customer outcome or comprehensive quality claim
